'''Xenoanalyst II''' was the designation of a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was present in [[3638 BBY]] aboard the ''[[Gray Secant]]''. It was programmed to challenge visitors to combat for ability evaluation.
